bluetooth: move property_handler_callback on ExportedObjectManagerWrapper Class ExportedObjectManagerWrapper has property_handler_setup_callback_ private property that can only be set through method SetPropertyHandlerSetupCallback(). The property is only used when the method AddExportedInterface() is called. This patch remove the property_handler_setup_callback_ property, and add a property_handler_setup_callback parameter to AddExportedInterface() instead. This is needed to allow ExportedObjectManagerWrapper to be shared by many components so that those components can freely define the property handler callbacks per object/interface. network_WiFi_LinkMonitorFailure: don't fail upon lack of disconnect This test is testing to ensure (a) Shill's link monitor detects a link failure (e.g., failing ARP requests) within a certain timeout and (b) the rest of the stack (driver, wpa_supplicant) responds appropriately when Shill requests a WiFi Reattach() Reattach() is just a "Reassociation attempt": https://w1.fi/wpa_supplicant/devel/dbus.html#dbus_interface which traditionally resulted in a disconnect/reconnect, but is now widened such that some drivers support the reassociation attempt directly, and therefore do not yield any disconnect. See https://crbug.com/990012#c4 for some more information about this. Anyway, the result is the 'iw event' only shows the "connected" event, with no disconnect in the meantime. This was confirmed in a WiFi sniffer packet capture. Since this behavior doesn't really violate (b), we should loosen this restriction, and avoid failing the test just because we didn't see a disconnect. A Reassociation should be as good as a Deauth/Reassociation in terms of "un-sticking" the driver. BUG=chromium:990012 TEST=run it on veyron_minnie-kernelnext Change-Id: Iddc454cbfde00aa23e60de1cfdf9d956e79d2f9a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1737468 Tested-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Neeraj Poojary <npoojary@chromium.org>
